auth.label: API Key
auth.description: LeadBoxer API key sent with the x-api-key header. Generate or copy it from Integrations settings at https://app.leadboxer.com.

actions.name: lookup_domain
actions.description: Enrich a domain name with LeadBoxer organization and firmographic data.

domain.description: The clean domain name to enrich, without a protocol or www prefix.

datasetId.description: The LeadBoxer dataset ID whose credits should be charged for the lookup.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for a LeadBoxer domain lookup.

organizationEmployeeCountRangeCode.description: The code for the organization's employee-count range.

organizationEmployeeCountRangeName.description: The label for the organization's employee-count range.

organizationSource.description: The source used for the organization enrichment.

organizationReportDate.description: The date of the organization enrichment report.

organizationState.description: The organization's state or administrative region.

organizationAddress.description: The organization address returned by LeadBoxer.

organizationSocialLinks.description: The organization social links returned by LeadBoxer.

outputSchema.description: The organization enrichment details returned by LeadBoxer.

actions.name: lookup_ip
actions.description: Enrich an IPv4 or IPv6 address with LeadBoxer organization, network, and geolocation data.

ip.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address to enrich.

datasetId.description: The LeadBoxer dataset ID whose credits should be charged for the lookup.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for a LeadBoxer IP address lookup.

ipRange.description: The CIDR range that contains the searched IP address.

ipCountryCode.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code associated with the IP address.

ipCountryName.description: The full country name associated with the IP address.

ipSubContinent.description: The sub-continent or geographic region associated with the IP address.

ipRegionName.description: The administrative region or state associated with the IP address.

ipCity.description: The city associated with the IP address.

ipLatitude.description: The latitude coordinate returned for the IP address.

ipLongitude.description: The longitude coordinate returned for the IP address.

ipTimezone.description: The timezone associated with the IP address.

ipIsp.description: The internet service provider associated with the IP address.

ipOrganization.description: The registered organization associated with the IP address.

ipDomain.description: The primary domain associated with the IP address.

ipUsageType.description: The LeadBoxer usage classification for the IP address.

searchIp.description: The normalized IP address used for the lookup.

searchResponseTimeMs.description: The lookup response time in milliseconds.

outputSchema.description: The IP enrichment details returned by LeadBoxer.
